packageRules.description: Group all stuttgart-things first-party images into a single PR

homerun2: one PR per component (image and -kustomize together, as in stuttgart-things/flux#208) instead of the combined stuttgart-things images group, and no minimum release age. ghcr publishes these OCI tags without a release timestamp, so under minimumReleaseAge the update waited on the stability check forever and the catalog never got a homerun2 PR (stuttgart-things/homerun-library#127).

Hold the redis chart at 17.x (same rule as stuttgart-things/flux). 22.x refuses the stuttgart-things redis-stack-server/redis-sentinel images apps/homerun2/install and apps/redis-stack use, unless global.security.allowInsecureImages is set, moves the password to REDIS_PASSWORD_FILE and adds readOnlyRootFilesystem -- untested with our start scripts (stuttgart-things/flux#355). Migrate deliberately, not via renovate.
Auto-merge patch and digest updates once CI passes — keeps low-risk bumps from piling up
Flag major updates for manual review; never auto-merge

Catalog self-pin (targetRevision). Promotion is deliberate: never auto-merge — a human merges the bump PR to roll a new release out to clusters. minimumReleaseAge=0 so the PR appears as soon as a tag is cut.

schmetterpause is pre-1.0, and its patch surface IS the interface apps/schmetterpause/install drives: gateway name, hostname in three places, both secretStoreRefs, the two listener names. Under 0.x a rename in that surface is a MINOR bump, not a major - so a minor here can require a chart change and must not ride along on the patch auto-merge rule, nor disappear into the shared 'stuttgart-things images' group where a reviewer sees only a batch title. Fold these back in once upstream reaches 1.0.0.
